special_cards.description: Playing a 5 skips the next player
Playing an Ace reverses the play direction

Playing a 7 requires the player to say 'have a (very * number of consecutive 7s before this) nice day'. E.g. first 7: 'have a nice day', second consecutive 7: 'have a very nice day', third: 'have a very very nice day', etc.
Playing a 10 requires the player to name a member of the Beatles
Playing a Jack means any player may call out a suit; the first player to name a suit changes the active suit to that suit. A Jack cannot be played on another Jack.
Playing a Queen allows the player to take another turn immediately
Playing a King requires the player to hit (tap/slap) another player

suit_rules.description: Must say '(value) of spades' when playing a spade (e.g. '5 of spades', 'King of spades')
When playing the Ace of Spades, the player must sing 'flying swooping ace of spades, doo dah doo dah' and all other players must sing 'doo dah doo dah'
Must knock on the table when playing a heart

consecutive_rules.description: When 3 cards of the same value are played consecutively, the 3rd player must throw a card at another player (that player must take it). Each subsequent player who continues playing the same value must also throw a card at any player.

special_case.description: If the 3 consecutive cards are 6's, 'evil card' must be announced

play_matching.description: To play a card it must match the top card's suit or rank. Jacks are excluded from the rank-matching requirement (since they change suit).

speech_rules.name: announce_spades
speech_rules.description: Must say '(value) of spades' when playing a spade

speech_rules.name: ace_of_spades_song
speech_rules.required_phrase_player: flying swooping ace of spades, doo dah doo dah
speech_rules.description: Ace of Spades: player sings 'flying swooping ace of spades, doo dah doo dah', all others must sing 'doo dah doo dah'

speech_rules.name: have_a_nice_day
speech_rules.very_chain_rule: one 'very' per consecutive 7 played before this one (0 for the first 7, 1 for the second, etc.)
speech_rules.description: Must say 'have a (very * N) nice day' when playing a 7, where N is the number of consecutive 7s played before this one

speech_rules.name: name_beatles_member
speech_rules.description: Must name a member of the Beatles when playing a 10

speech_rules.name: knock_on_hearts
speech_rules.description: Must knock on the table when playing a heart

speech_rules.name: last_card
speech_rules.description: Must announce 'last card' when down to one card

speech_rules.name: mao
speech_rules.description: Must say 'Mao' after playing your last card to win the game

speech_rules.name: false_mao
speech_rules.description: Saying 'Mao' at any time other than after playing your last card is a penalty

speech_rules.name: no_cursing
speech_rules.description: Cursing at any time is a penalty

speech_rules.name: evil_card_announcement
speech_rules.description: When 3 consecutive 6's are played, 'evil card' must be announced

play_rules.name: matching_suit_or_rank
play_rules.description: Card must match suit or rank of top card (Jacks are excluded from rank matching since they change suit)

play_rules.name: jack_on_jack_forbidden
play_rules.description: A Jack cannot be played on top of another Jack

play_rules.name: your_turn
play_rules.description: Can only play on your turn

play_rules.name: turn_action
play_rules.description: On your turn you may either draw 1 card or play 1 card

restrictions.description: During a Point of Order: players may not touch their cards, and players may not say 'Point of Order' except as part of 'end Point of Order'
